title: Student Assistant, Regional Marketing, Planetary Health Biosolutions - Novonesis
description_md:
**Interesseret i en karriere, der gør en forskel?**




Are you passionate about marketing, digital content creation and learning about new industries? Would you like to combine creativity with hands-on coordination while collaborating with a broad range of stakeholders in an international environment?

Join our Regional Marketing team in Planetary Health Biosolutions, where you will contribute to marketing and customer engagement activities across digital campaigns, content, sales materials and events. You will become part of a fast-paced, project-based environment that offers a steep learning curve and the opportunity to build practical experience relevant to future marketing and strategic roles.

**The role & your impact**

As our new Student Assistant in Regional Marketing, you will support the planning and execution of marketing and customer engagement activities. Working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners, you will help turn marketing needs into engaging content, effective sales materials and well-coordinated events.

**Your key responsibilities in this role**

* Create engaging LinkedIn content across segments, including challenge- and event-specific communications.
* Coordinate marketing activities and stakeholders, following up on timelines, deliverables and outstanding actions.
* Work with external graphic designers and print agencies to develop value-driven collateral for products, services and customer engagement events.
* Customize and localize sales collateral in response to requests from sales teams and business partners, including coordinating printing and shipment.
* Support customer events, conferences and exhibitions by coordinating event preparation and materials such as banners and giveaways.
* Support marketing projects and reporting, including the setup of a new marketing library and development of visual presentations and reports communicating sales and performance insights.

**What you’ll need to be successful in this role**

We are looking for a student who:

* Is enrolled in the third year of a bachelor’s degree or first year of a master’s degree at a Danish university or business school, within economics, finance, international business, marketing or another relevant field.
* Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Has excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Is structured, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.
* Communicates confidently and is comfortable collaborating with different stakeholders.

**Additional skills & interests we value**

It would be an advantage if you:

* Are interested in both the creative and practical sides of marketing and enjoy combining communication with hands-on coordination.
* Enjoy working in an international environment.
* Are curious about learning new industries and working across a broad stakeholder base.

**What we offer you**

This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on marketing experience in an international organization while working across content creation, sales enablement, events and stakeholder coordination.

You will join a fast-paced, project-based environment with a steep learning curve from day one and gain practical exposure that can help you develop skills relevant to future roles within marketing and strategy.

**Working conditions**

The position is based in Lyngby.

We expect you to work approximately **15–20 hours per week**, spread across **two to three days**, with flexibility around exams. There is also an opportunity to work from home.

**Relevant information**

**Application deadline:**29 October 2026

**Contact Informa**tion: Katharina Klager-Vermeersch, Head of Regional Marketing - katkl@novonesis.com

**Vores formål viser vejen**

I Novonesis ved vi, at løsninger forankret i biologi kan hjælpe med at løse verdens største udfordringer. Siden vi begyndte for mere end et århundrede siden, har dette været vores pejlemærke. Det er sådan, vi er nået så langt. Og det er sådan, vi vil påvirke fremtiden. Nu, mere end nogensinde, har verden brug for forandring. Og med biosolutions er mulighederne for transformation uendelige. Hvis vores formål giver mening for dig, opfordrer vi dig til at søge.

**Muligheder for alle**

Vi er dedikerede til en inkluderende rekrutteringsproces og lige muligheder for alle ansøgere. Derfor beder vi dig om ikke at vedhæfte en ansøgning eller et foto og i stedet inkludere et par sætninger i dit CV, hvor du forklarer din motivation for at ansøge.

Vi træffer alle ansættelsesbeslutninger baseret på forretningsbehov og byder kandidater med en bred vifte af baggrunde velkommen, herunder etnicitet, religion, køn, seksuel orientering, alder, handicap eller veteranstatus.

**Udforsk andre stillinger**

Hvis denne stilling ikke passer til dig, kan du stadig finde andre muligheder hos os. Du er velkommen til at udforske ledige stillinger eller oprette en jobagent for at holde dig opdateret om fremtidige muligheder på [novonesis.com/Career](http://novonesis.com/Career).
